s: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

g: Compare Things with 跟…(不)一樣

s: 這座橋對車子的高度有限制，開大車的人要小心。
Zhè zuò qiáo duì chēzi de gāodù yǒu xiànzhì, kāi dàchē de rén yào xiǎoxīn.
This bridge has a height restriction for vehicles; those driving large vehicles should be careful.
